latents.fact: a {ADJ} signalling device has been left against the parapet wall, pointed inward rather than out — whatever it was aimed at is inside the structure
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} device for signalling or observation. It is still set for a message no one sends anymore.

latents.fact: the wind carries a voice — or the shape of one — periodically and without source
a rope or bracket ladder down the outer face, below the parapet
latents.exit_desc: The ladder descends the outer face to passages below the wall.
